# PV Magazine: China adds 315 GW of solar in 2025

Published: 28 Jan 2026. By Vincent Shaw.

## Key Findings
- 2025 new solar: **315.07 GW (AC)** — record. New wind: **119.33 GW** — record.
- Cumulative installed power capacity end 2025: **3.89 TW (3,890 GW)**, up **16.1% YoY**.
- Solar: **1.20 TW (1,200 GW)**, up **35.4%**. Wind: **0.64 TW (640 GW)**, up **22.9%**.
- Solar + wind = **47.3% of total installed capacity**.
- Non-fossil (incl. hydro + nuclear): **60.4% of total** vs **39.6% thermal** — **historic crossover**.
- Large power plants (6MW+): averaged **3,119 full-load hours** in 2025, down **312 hours** from 2024.
- December 2025 solar additions: **>40 GW** (comparable to annual installations of many major PV markets).
- **2026 forecast (CPIA)**: conservative 185 GW, mainstream 215-220 GW, optimistic 275 GW. Central view: **20-25% YoY decline**.
- BloombergNEF baseline: ~273 GW (AC) in 2026.
